purpose: Audit all legal discard actions on fresh outcome-unfiltered public roots before choosing guidance or training labels. Public-belief returns measure continuation-dependent preferences, not actual playing strength.

dataset.selection: Every recorded eligible root, no outcome or action filtering. No extra roots sampled to fill the3 absent seat/rule cells.

model.selection: Fixed original update79 parent derivative; not a winner selected from the new comparison.

pairing: Identical independently sampled public scenarios for every legal action and each continuation. Each batch is independent; no live private deck, actual seed, future moves or hidden bids are used.
action_set: All root engine-legal DiscardPowerPlant moves in exact engine order, no shortlist and no neural-proposal filtering.
root_model_proposal: Record the original frozen model proposal and verify that re-encoding each public root reproduces it.
neural_continuation: The same frozen parent policy controls all actors in simulated continuations; this is a modelling assumption, not a claim to predict actual opponents.
outputs: Every sample outcome and cap flag for every action, not only winning actions.
Runtime split between engine and policy, neural decision counts.
Independent-batch winner-set agreement, continuation-policy disagreements, original-proposal regret estimates and all ties.
caps: A truncated continuation is missing evidence, never a loss. Preserve capped rows, flag their targets invalid and diagnose before accepting guidance.
interpretation: Descriptive teacher reliability only. A stable preference or high simulated return is not demonstrated strength; a fresh complete-game intervention comparison is required before promotion. No optimizer or final-test seeds in this experiment.

performance_basis.scope: Local HX370 public-neural continuation throughput smoke on1 root,16 rollouts; no strength or teacher-quality claim.
performance_basis.caution: One local HX370 smoke, not a full HF throughput estimate; record full-job timing before scaling or changing hardware.

launch_status: Protocol frozen; audit implementation and HF launch are next.
